videos.title: Stars, Stripes, VIPs and Protests: Brussels hosts US Independence bash
videos.transcript: Thousands of guests traveled down to Brussels on Sunday to celebrate the 250th anniversary of US independence. The invite-only event is held in a large park in the Belgian capital, which is located near the EU institutions. >> And everyone gathered in Brussels to celebrate 250 years of American independence. >> US [music] Ambassador to Belgium Bill White opened the ceremony. Among those attending are Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever, NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte, and European [music] Parliament President Roberta Metsola. US military personnel based in the Belgian capital are also in attendance. However, the event drew widespread criticism. On Sunday morning, Greenpeace unrolled a massive banner in the city center condemning the occasion to promote Trump's political and corporate agenda. And several organizations, including Extinction Rebellion and Rise for Climate, demonstrated outside of the park in protest against the privatization of the public park.
videos.summary: Thousands of guests gathered in Brussels on Sunday to celebrate the 250th anniversary of American independence at an invite-only event held in a park near the EU institutions. High-profile attendees included Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever, NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte, and European Parliament President Roberta Metsola. However, the event also attracted protests from environmental groups who criticised both the political agenda behind the celebration and the use of a public park.
